subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like a furious salesman losing his temper: the face twists in anger, the brows slam down, the mouth opens and closes wide and fast as if shouting, the head jerks forward; the hands clench into fists in front of the chest and shake; then the smile returns as he settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
